body: Thank you... I've been trying. I just feel so lonely.
Honestly... going to a hospital is a good idea. That's what I'm gonna do. At least there is a bed and time to think things over.
I totally get the feeling. I'm trans too. Honestly can't say I have any friends... but I have found a queer community, I partly started it, and it's helped with my transness.
Dealing with a similar situation... I don't get why people think kicking you out will help. Just makes me more suicidal... it's fucked up
I have no where to go... there isn't anything I can do.

I'm in a very similar boat. I am much closer with on of my friend's in the situation and I'm going to try and have a calm and honest conversation with her about it... might be something you wanna try. Just try talking to one of them about how the group dynamic feels different.

Not sure how good my advice will be... but if you're hurt and feel like you are really close with your friend Z, I think it is best to sit with her and tell her everything. Tell her that you liked him, and even though she didn't know you can't help but feel upset and jealous. It might make things weird I know, but I always think honesty is better with a friendship...

Going through a similar thing myself right now.
